verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a drop-in flow: Identity Verification runs inside Link, with client callbacks (onEvent, onSuccess). It covers documentary ID authentication and liveness/face-match, so the developer does not build capture UI, and results arrive via STATUS_UPDATED webhooks and the Dashboard. However, the pack never shows the server-side session creation call, a hosted redirect option, or an API call that reads the verification result. Missing for 10: documented server-side session/token creation, hosted redirect URL flow, explicit result-retrieval API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a complete document-plus-selfie verification with a hosted or drop-in flow — create a session server-side, redirect or embed, and read the result — without building capture UI myself

citations.quote: After integrating Identity Verification using Link, you can use Link's client-side callbacks to see how your users are progressing through the flow.
onSuccess will fire when a user has successfully completed the Link flow.
